negative_reviews.author: Nicholas Srai
negative_reviews.text:
Dropping from 5 Stars to 1 Star due to shocking management service.

I originally left a 5-star review after an incredible dinner, but returning Saturday evening almost before close completely ruined this venue for me.

We stopped by just to give a friend a quick glance inside for a future visit. The doors were open and people were still eating, but the female manager was at the front host desk looking visibly frustrated while sorting something out.

When I asked if we could show our friend around, she was extremely rude and hostile. When I clarified we didn't want a table, she shut us down with an awful attitude. The male host actually tried to intervene and say it was fine, but her hostility made us walk away completely disgusted.

What makes this so disappointing is that on launch night, this exact same manager was boasting about how welcoming she is and how she treats all her staff "like her own children." The contrast between that fake charm and her actual demeanor was shocking.

To top it off, chairs had already been stacked on tables all across the dining room while paying customers were still eating, making the place look messy and making guests feel rushed.

Great food means nothing if management treats returning customers with total disrespect. I won't be back or recommending this place again.
